gap_analysis.interpretation: Calendar missing minutes include market closures, weekends, holidays, minutes without ticks and potentially missing data.

notes.timezone_inference: Timezone must be derived from broker or source metadata. Do not automatically assume Europe/Helsinki.
notes.timestamp_semantics: It is not yet known whether Date represents candle open time or candle close time.
notes.volume_interpretation: Volume may represent tick volume rather than traded volume and must be verified from the source.
notes.missing_bar_policy: Missing one-minute bars are detected but not interpolated or forward-filled.
notes.precision_note: Prices are currently stored as float32. Float64 is preferred for validation, execution and PnL calculations.
